_schema_note: Each use case = a buyer-intent search pattern (e.g., 'best HVAC software for solo contractors'). ranked_picks are tool slugs in priority order, handpicked to match the specific buyer profile, not auto-ranked.

use_cases.h1: Best HVAC Software for Solo Contractors in 2026
use_cases.meta_description: HVAC software picked by hand for solo and 1-2 person HVAC businesses, with each pick's starting price, HVAC fit, free trial and QuickBooks support, plus a checklist for one-truck operators.
use_cases.buyer_profile: Solo HVAC contractor or 1-2 person operation
use_cases.intro: If you run an HVAC business alone or with one helper, you need fast quoting, simple invoicing and a way to take payment from the truck more than you need dispatch for a large team. The tools below were picked by hand for that profile. They differ in price model, trial and trade fit, and not every pick meets every point in the checklist, so check each one against it.
buying_criteria: A total monthly cost that fits a one-truck budget, counting any per-user fees
A mobile app that handles quotes, invoices and payments, since you will use it from the truck
Built-in payment processing
Published prices, so you can compare without a sales call
A free trial so you can test it on real jobs before committing

use_cases.h1: Best Plumbing Software for Small Teams (4-15 Techs) in 2026
use_cases.meta_description: Plumbing software picked by hand for companies with 4-15 technicians, with each pick's starting price, plumbing fit, free trial and QuickBooks support, plus a checklist for growing teams.
use_cases.buyer_profile: Plumbing company, 4-15 technicians, residential + light commercial
use_cases.intro: A plumbing company with 4 to 15 technicians needs real dispatching, an accounting link and pricing that still makes sense as the team grows. The tools below were picked by hand for that profile. They charge in different ways (a company price with users included plus a fee per extra user, a flat company price with unlimited users, or a quote), so compare each at your own team size.
buying_criteria: A price model you have checked at your team size (per user, per company, or a plan with included users)
Real dispatching, not just a calendar
A QuickBooks integration for the edition your accountant uses (Online or Desktop)
Online booking and customer messages
Published prices or a written quote you can compare side by side

use_cases.h1: Best Software for Residential Cleaning Businesses in 2026
use_cases.meta_description: Software picked by hand for residential cleaning businesses with 1-30 cleaners: recurring scheduling, crew tools and billing, with each pick's starting price, cleaning fit and free trial.
use_cases.buyer_profile: Residential cleaning business, 1-30 cleaners, recurring-service model
use_cases.intro: A residential cleaning business runs on recurring appointments, so it needs recurring scheduling, reminders and billing on a weekly or every-other-week cadence, plus a way to see where crews are. The tools below were picked by hand for that profile and do different jobs: some are booking and scheduling tools for cleaners, some are general field service tools, Connecteam is a workforce app for time tracking and team communication that runs alongside them, and Vonigo is built for franchise and multi-location brands.
buying_criteria: Recurring scheduling (weekly, every other week, monthly)
GPS clock-in or geofencing for crew check-ins
Automatic billing on the recurring schedule
A customer portal where clients can skip a visit, reschedule or update a card
Cleaning workflows such as checklists and before and after photos

use_cases.h1: Best Software for Commercial Pest Control Operators in 2026
use_cases.meta_description: Pest control software picked by hand for commercial operators: routing, chemical records, recurring service agreements and commercial invoicing, with each pick's pest control fit and pricing model.
use_cases.buyer_profile: Commercial pest control company, 5-100 employees, B2B contract-based
use_cases.intro: Commercial pest control adds contract terms, multi-unit and multi-site accounts and detailed service records to the route and chemical tracking of residential pest work. The tools below were picked by hand for that profile. They range from quote-based pest platforms to a small-business tool with published prices and a franchise-focused service platform, so check each against the list below; PestPac, for example, lists IPM and multi-unit support for commercial work.
buying_criteria: Route optimization for dense routes
Chemical application records that meet your state's rules
Recurring service agreement management
Commercial invoicing (purchase order numbers, payment terms)
Signature capture on a phone to confirm each service

use_cases.h1: Best Electrical Contractor Software for Growing Teams (10-30) in 2026
use_cases.meta_description: Field service and commercial service platforms picked by hand for electrical contractors with 10-30 electricians, with each pick's electrical fit, pricing model and QuickBooks support.
use_cases.intro: An electrical contractor with 10 to 30 electricians doing both residential and commercial work needs dispatch for several crews, project as well as service work, and reporting by team. The tools below were picked by hand for that profile. They differ in focus: some are built for residential service and some for commercial service and project work, so match them to your own work mix, and see the FAQ below for which ones publish prices.
buying_criteria: Dispatching across several techs, with skill or certification matching
Project work and service work in one platform, or a clear plan for running two
Inventory and tool tracking
An accounting integration your bookkeeper will use
Reports by team or technician

use_cases.h1: Best Roofing Software for Insurance Restoration Work in 2026
use_cases.meta_description: Roofing software picked by hand for contractors with insurance restoration work: insurance job tracking, aerial measurements, photos and production, with each pick's roofing fit and pricing model.
use_cases.buyer_profile: Roofing contractor, 5-100 employees, insurance restoration + retail mix
use_cases.intro: Roofing companies that work insurance claims need to document damage, handle the carrier's estimate and supplements, order measurements and materials, and track production across crews. The tools below were picked by hand for that profile. AccuLynx and JobNimbus are built around roofing, while ServiceTitan, JobTread and Buildertrend are broader platforms that list roofing. Check Xactimate support carefully: JobNimbus connects to Xactimate only on its legacy financials, and AccuLynx lists no Xactimate integration.
buying_criteria: Xactimate support, if you work insurance claims (check how it works, not just whether it is listed)
Aerial measurement integrations (such as EagleView, Hover or GAF QuickMeasure)
Photo and document management for claim files
Production tracking across multi-day jobs with several crews
Supplier ordering (such as ABC Supply, SRS Distribution or QXO)

use_cases.h1: Best Landscaping Software with Snow Management in 2026
use_cases.meta_description: Landscaping software picked by hand for companies that add snow and ice work in winter, with each pick's landscaping fit, pricing model and free trial, plus a snow checklist.
use_cases.buyer_profile: Landscape company offering year-round services including commercial snow management
use_cases.intro: A landscape company that runs snow and ice work in winter needs storm routes, per-push or per-event billing, salt and material tracking and early-morning dispatch, on top of its green-season routes. The tools below were picked by hand for that profile, but not all of them list snow features: Aspire and Service Autopilot do, so check snow workflows in a demo of any other pick.
buying_criteria: Snow routes kept separate from green-season routes
Billing per push, per event, per inch or by season
Salt and de-icer tracking
Early-morning crew dispatch for storms
Crew-based operations, not just single technicians

use_cases.h1: Best QuickBooks-Native Software for Trades Contractors in 2026
use_cases.meta_description: Field service and contractor software picked by hand for businesses that keep their books in QuickBooks, with each pick's QuickBooks editions, trade fit and pricing model.
use_cases.buyer_profile: Trades contractor whose accountant insists on QuickBooks-tight integration
use_cases.intro: If your accountant works in QuickBooks, the editions a tool supports and the way its sync runs narrow your choice. The tools below were picked by hand for that profile, and each lists QuickBooks Online and Desktop. They differ in how they sync: Knowify syncs both ways with QuickBooks Online (Desktop on its Enterprise plan), FieldEdge markets a real-time, two-way integration, and Method:CRM and Smart Service also list QuickBooks Enterprise. Check sync direction and timing for each before you buy.
buying_criteria: Two-way QuickBooks sync, not just a one-way push
Support for the edition you use: QuickBooks Online, Desktop or Enterprise
Job costing that updates as work is completed
AIA progress billing, if you do construction work
Certified payroll, if you work on public projects (ask; none of these picks lists it)
